questions.question: If the polynomial 6x⁴ + 8x³ + 17x² + 21x + 7 is divided by another polynomial 3x² + 4x +1, the remainder comes out to be ax + b, find a and b.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Polynomial 6x4 + 8x3 + 17x2 + 21x + 7 is divided by another polynomial 3x2 + 4x +1

**Concept used:**

In such questions, we fix non-zero value of x and then calculate and compare values of remainder and quotient and solve using options.

**Calculation:**

Let x = 1,

then dividend 6x4 + 8x3 + 17x2 + 21x + 7 (x = 1) = 6 + 8 + 17 + 21 + 7 = 59 

and divisor 3x2 + 4x +1 (x = 1) = 3 + 4 + 1 = 8

When 6x4 + 8x3 + 17x2 + 21x + 7 is divided by polynomial 3x2 + 4x +1, that is, when 59 is divided by 8 then remainder comes out to be 3

∴ ax + b (x = 1) = 3

⇒ a + b = 3

Only option that satisfies a + b = 3 is option 2) 

**NOTE:** if more than one option satisfies then we check the satisfying options with another variable value of x.

II. Organic farming is more beneficial to farmers.

options.text: Either assumption I or II is implicit.

Person B reads 8 pages in an hour. 

There are two chapters of 72 pages that are difficult for person B to read in the book, so person B takes double the time to read those pages.

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A to finish the book = 250/6 = 41 hrs 40 mins

Time taken by B to finish the book = (250 - 72) pages at 8 pages per hour and 72 pages at 4 pages per hour (∵ double the time ⇒ half the speed)

= 178/8 + 72/4

= 89/4 + 72/4

= 161/4

= 40 hrs 15 mins 

∴ Comparing time taken by A and B, we conclude that B finishes the book first and (41 hrs 40 mins - 40 hrs 15 mins ) = 1 hr 25 min sooner.

questions.question: The total population of a village is 4,000. The number of males and females increases by 10% and 20% respectively and consequently the population of the village becomes 4500. What was the number of males in the village prior to the new members coming in?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total population of a village is 4,000. 

The number of males and females increases by 10% and 20% respectively and consequently the population of the village becomes 4500

**Concept used:**

Weighted Average = (n1A1 + n2A2)/(n1 + n2)

**Calculation:**

Percentage increase in population = (4500 - 4000)/4000 × 100 = 12.5%

Putting values, we get, 12.5 = (n1 × 10 + n2 × 20)/(n1 + n2)

⇒ 12.5 × n1 + 12.5 × n2 = 10 × n1 + 20 × n2

⇒ 2.5 × n1 = 7.5 × n2

⇒ n1/n2 = 3/1 = male/female and total population of a village is 4,000

∴ Number of males in the village prior to the new members coming in = 3/4 × 4000 = 3000

Ram has a movie in his pen drive that takes 1.75 GB of space. He wants to share it with his friends. The speed of transferring the file is 2 MB/s. How much time will it take to transfer the file?

(1 GB = 1000 MB)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ram has a movie in his pen drive that takes 1.75 GB of space. (1 GB = 1000 MB)

The speed of transferring the file is 2 MB/s.

**Calculation:**

Time taken to transfer the file = [1.75 GB]/[2 MB/s] = 1.75 × 1000 MB × 1/2MB/s = 1.75 × 500 seconds

= 1.75 × 500 × 1/60 minutes 

= 875/60 minutes

= 14 minutes 35 seconds

questions.question: A glass cylinder with diameter 20 cm has water to a height of 9 cm. A metal cube of 8 cm edge is immersed in it completely. Calculate the height (correct to I decimal place) by which the water will rise in the cylinder (by taking π = 3.142).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Rise in height** (h) = **Volume of immersed object** ÷ **Base area of cylinder**

h = 8³ ÷ (π × 10²)

h = 512 ÷ (3.142 × 100) = 512 ÷ 314.2

h ≈ 1.629 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 1.6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of **cylinder** = 20 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 10 cm

Edge of **metal cube** (a) = 8 cm

Value of π = 3.142

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917d644c78146ef8150a56d6835fff78b1cc8f4f828367804d8415f602f3853.png] 

**Formula:**

Volume of **water displaced** = Volume of **metal cube**

π × r² × h = a³

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3.142 × 10 × 10 × h = 8 × 8 × 8

⇒ 314.2 × h = 512

⇒ h = 512 ÷ 314.2

⇒ h = 1.6295...

⇒ h ≈ 1.6 cm (correct to 1 decimal place)

**∴ The correct answer is 1.6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Archimedes Principle (Volume)

When an object is completely immersed in a liquid, the **volume of liquid displaced** is equal to the **volume of the object**.

Cylinder and Cube Volumes

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h and Volume of Cube = a³, where r is radius, h is height, and a is the edge.

Rise in Liquid Level

Rise in height (h) = Volume of solid ÷ Area of the cross-section of the container.</p

questions.question:
District XYZ has 50,000 voters; out of them, 20% are urban voters and 80% rural voters. For an election, 25% of the rural voters were shifted to the urban area. Out of the voters in both rural and urban areas, 60% are honest, 70% are hardworking, and 35% are both honest and hardworking.

Two candidates, A and B, contested the election. Candidate B swept the urban vote, while Candidate A found favour with the rural voters. Voters who were both honest and hardworking voted for NOTA. How many votes were polled in favour of candidate A, candidate B and NOTA, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

District XYZ has 50,000 voters; out of them, 20% are urban voters and 80% rural voters.

**Calculation:**

Total votes = 50000

⇒ Urban votes originally = 20/100 × 50000 = 10000 and Rural votes originally = 80/100 × 50000 = 40000

For election, 25% of the rural voters were shifted to the urban area 

⇒ 25/100 × 40000 = 10000 rural votes shifted to urban area.

⇒ Now, Urban votes = 10000 + 10000 = 20000 and Rural votes = 40000 - 10000 = 30000

Out of the voters in both rural and urban areas, 60% are honest, 70% are hardworking, and 35% are both honest and hardworking.

Voters who were both honest and hardworking voted for NOTA.

∴ Votes swept by NOTA = 35% of urban + 35% of rural = 35/100 × 20000 + 35/100 × 30000 = 17500 

Candidate A found favour with the rural voters, rural voters left = 100% - 35% = 65% of rural voters

∴ Votes swept by A = 65/100 × 30000 = 19500

Candidate B found favour with the urban voters, Urban voters left = 100% - 35% = 65% of urban voters

∴ Votes swept by B = 65/100 × 20000 = 13000

⇒ Votes polled in favor of candidate A, candidate B and NOTA are 19500, 13000 and 17500 respectively

questions.question: There is a 6-storey building with 20 rooms on each floor. Some toxic material is concealed in the building. Three groups of officers start the search operation simultaneously. The first group searches the 1st and 2nd floors. The second group handles the 3rd and 4th floors. The third group takes over the 5th and 6th floors. If it takes 1 minute to reach any nearest floor and 1 minute to search each room, how much time will it take to complete the entire search operation?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

6-storey building with 20 rooms on each floor

Three groups of officers start the search operation simultaneously

The first group searches the 1st and 2nd floors

The second group handles the 3rd and 4th floors

The third group takes over the 5th and 6th floors

It takes 1 minute to reach any nearest floor

It takes 1 minute to search each room

**Formula Used:**

Total time for each group = time to search rooms on both floors + time to move between floors + time to reach the first floor they search

**Calculation:**

**First group:**

Time to reach the 1st floor: 1 minute

Time to search 20 rooms on the 1st floor: 20 minutes.

Time to move to the 2nd floor: 1 minute

Time to search 20 rooms on the 1st floor: 20 minutes.

Total time = 1 + 20 + 20 + 1 = 42 minutes

**Second group:**

Time to reach the 3rd floor: 3 minutes

Time to search 20 rooms on the 3rd floor: 20 minutes.

Time to move to the 4th floor: 1 minute

Time to search 20 rooms on the 4th floor: 20 minutes.

Total time = 3 + 20 + 20 + 1 = 44 minutes 

**Third group:**

Time to reach the 5th floor: 5 minutes

Time to search 20 rooms on the 5th floor: 20 minutes.

Time to move to the 6th floor: 1 minute

Time to search 20 rooms on the 6th floor: 20 minutes.

Total time = 5 + 20 + 20 + 1 = 46 minutes

Product of the zeros of quadratic polynomial f(x) = p2 + qx + r is r/p

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

given, Sum of the squares of zeros of quadratic polynomial f(x) = 40

(KP)/(PM) = (4)/(13) and KN = 20.4 cm

⇒ (KQ)/(QN) = (4)/(13)

Let KQ = 4x and QN = 13x 

Given KN = 20.4 cm and KN = KQ + QN

 ⇒ x = 1.2
